Game Overview

In Idle Desert Life, the core idea is straightforward: survive and thrive in Idle Desert Life's desolate world. Construct rafts, rescue fellow survivors, and lead your team to explore new lands. Experience diverse cultures and rebuild civilization with strategic resource management and captivating adventures. Can you complete the ultimate shipbuilding challenge and become a desert legend?

How to Play

The moment-to-moment gameplay in Idle Desert Life is easy to pick up. Survive and thrive in Idle Desert Life's desolate world. Construct rafts, rescue fellow survivors, and lead your team to explore new lands. Experience diverse cultures and rebuild civilization with strategic resource management and captivating adventures.
